arguments.value: Gary A. Fenner (born 1947, St. Joseph, Missouri) is a senior United States district judge for the Western District of Missouri, taking senior status in 2015 after being appointed by President Bill Clinton in 1996. A graduate of the University of Kansas and the University of Missouri-Kansas City School of Law, he began his legal career in private practice and as an assistant city attorney in St. Joseph, and also taught business law at Webster College. Fenner served as a judge on Missouri’s Fifth Judicial Circuit from 1979 to 1987, then on the Missouri Court of Appeals, Western District, from 1988 to 1996, including as chief judge from 1994 to 1996, before his federal appointment.
